name: Rush
description: Add 1 to the Move characteristic of this fighter until the end of their activation.

name: Respite
description: A fighter cannot use this ability while within 1" of an enemy fighter. Remove (X) damage points from this fighter.
short: The fighter must not be within 1" of an enemy. Remove (X) damage from it.

name: Careful Aim
description: Add 1 to the **Shoot** characteristic of this fighter for its next **Ranged Attack** action this activation.
short: Add 1 to this fighter's **Shoot** for its next **Ranged Attack** this activation.

name: Diving Charge
description: A fighter can use this ability after making a move action where it fell more than 2" vertically. Until the end of their activation, you may add 1 to their Fight characteristic for every full 2" they fell.
short: Use this after a move where the fighter fell more than 2". Add 1 to its Fight for every full 2" it fell, until the end of its activation.

name: Inspiring Presence
description: Select a visible friendly fighter within 6" of this fighter that has not activated yet this battle round. You can activate that fighter immediately after this fighter's activation ends.
short: Pick a visible friendly fighter within 6" that has not activated yet. It activates right after this fighter.

name: Onslaught
description: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee attack actions made by this fighter until the end of their activation.
short: Add 1 to this fighter's Attacks for melee attacks, until the end of its activation.

name: Rampage
description: This fighter makes a bonus move action. Then, they can make a bonus attack action.
